items.title: [AI Feed Curator] State of the Feed — Week of October 5–11, 2026
items.content_html:
The Week of October 5–11, 2026 saw 7 pipeline runs, each fetching an average of 1,354 articles and delivering an average of 83 quality-scored articles. Category volume was led by ai-tech (126 articles), followed by news (98), wellness (70), homelab (58), science (56), local (50), climate (42), design (42), outdoors (13), homestead (12), and scifi (11). Scoring used the dimensional Q/R/L composite (quality, relevance, local) with weights of 0.25, 0.55, and 0.20 respectively.

Pipeline efficiency averaged a noise-to-signal ratio of 2.37 articles fetched per article delivered over 14 runs, with a range of 0.87 to 3.34. The ratio sat within its historical band this week and did not indicate an unusual degree of filtering overhead or unusually clean source material. New feeds added this period were GN CleanTechnica, Meshtastic Blog, My Cariboo Now, Cariboo News, Events, Weather and Local Radio, and Tsleil-Waututh Nation.

Feed health shows three sources with errors: CleanTechnica, Hacker News, and EEVblog. Top discovery candidates by score were One Earth (79.1), astroblogger.blogspot.com (72.6), and Machine Learning (64.7).

  • Block candidates still unblocked: Mother Jones: n ≥ 8 with nothing wanted. Block them in filters.json or rate why not.
  • Calibration change never landed: source_preferences.kagi_search_result_limit: Logged 2026-09-20 as 10 → 12; config still says 10.
